the clause قد جئناك is circumstantial (ḥāliyya). ﴿وَ﴾ the wāw is resumptive. ﴿السَّلامُ﴾ mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿عَلى مَنِ﴾ the preposition and the relative noun are attached to the khabar; the clause is resumptive. ﴿اتَّبَعَ﴾ a past verb whose fāʿil is latent; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿الْهُدى﴾ mafʿūl bihi, accusative by the fatḥa implied (muqaddara) on the alif owing to impossibility.

daas-irab:48-49.t: ﴿إِنَّا﴾ inna and its noun. ﴿قَدْ﴾ a particle of realisation (taḥqīq). ﴿أُوحِيَ﴾ a passive imperfect verb; the clause is the khabar (predicate) of inna. [Translator's note: so in the source; أوحي is a past verb.] ﴿إِلَيْنا﴾ [a preposition and its genitive noun] attached to (mutaʿalliq) أوحي. ﴿أَنَّ الْعَذابَ﴾ anna and its noun. ﴿عَلى مَنْ﴾ the preposition and the relative noun are attached to the omitted khabar. ﴿كَذَّبَ﴾ a past verb whose fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir); the clause has no grammatical position because it is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative. ﴿وَتَوَلَّى﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and تولى is an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent; the clause is conjoined (maʿṭūfa). [Translator's note: so in the source; تولى here is a past verb.] ﴿قالَ﴾ the clause is resumptive. ﴿فَمَنْ﴾ the fāʾ is the conjunctive one, and man is an interrogative noun, mubtadaʾ (subject); the clause is conjoined. ﴿رَبُّكُما﴾ khabar; the kāf is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), and the mīm and alif are for the dual; the clause is in the position of accusative as the maqūl al-qawl (object of the saying). ﴿يا﴾ a vocative particle. ﴿مُوسى﴾ the one addressed (munādā); the clause is in the position of accusative as the maqūl al-qawl.

daas-irab:50-52.t: ﴿قالَ﴾ the clause is initial (ibtidāʾiyya). ﴿رَبُّنَا﴾ mubtadaʾ (subject); nā is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the clause is the maqūl al-qawl (object of the saying). ﴿الَّذِي﴾ a relative noun in the position of nominative as khabar (predicate). ﴿أَعْطى﴾ the clause has no grammatical position because it is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿كُلَّ﴾ first mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿شَيْءٍ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿خَلْقَهُ﴾ second mafʿūl bihi. ﴿ثُمَّ هَدى﴾ the clause is conjoined to أعطى. ﴿قالَ﴾ the clause is resumptive. ﴿فَما﴾ the fāʾ is a conjunction. ﴿ما﴾ an interrogative noun in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ. ﴿بالُ﴾ khabar. ﴿الْقُرُونِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿الْأُولى﴾ an adjective (ṣifa), genitive (majrūr) by the implied (muqaddara) kasra; the clause فما بال etc. is in the position of accusative as mafʿūl bihi. ﴿قالَ﴾ the clause is resumptive. ﴿عِلْمُها﴾ mubtadaʾ; the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿عِنْدَ﴾ an adverb of place, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the khabar. ﴿رَبِّي﴾ muḍāf ilayhi; the yāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi; the clause is in the position of accusative as the maqūl al-qawl. ﴿فِي كِتابٍ﴾ [a preposition and its genitive noun] also attached to the khabar. ﴿لا يَضِلُّ﴾ lā is negative; يضل is an imperfect verb. ﴿رَبِّي﴾ fāʿil (agent); the yāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿وَ﴾ a conjunction. ﴿لا﴾ negative. ﴿يَنْسى﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by an implied ḍamma. In the verse is the declaration of Allah the Exalted's transcendence above error and forgetfulness. The clause ﴿لا يَضِلُّ﴾ etc. is resumptive, and the clause ﴿لا يَنْسى﴾ is conjoined to لا يضل; the object of ينسى is omitted.

daas-irab:53-55.t: ﴿الَّذِي﴾ the khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), its implied form being "هو"; the clause is resumptive. ﴿جَعَلَ﴾ the clause has no grammatical position because it is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative. ﴿لَكُمُ﴾ [a preposition and its genitive noun] attached to (mutaʿalliq) جعل. ﴿الْأَرْضَ﴾ first mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿مَهْداً﴾ second mafʿūl bihi. ﴿وَ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction. ﴿سَلَكَ﴾ the clause is conjoined (maʿṭūfa). ﴿لَكُمُ﴾ attached to the verb before it. ﴿فِيها﴾ attached to سلك. ﴿سُبُلًا﴾ mafʿūl bihi. ﴿وَ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction. ﴿أَنْزَلَ﴾ the clause is conjoined. ﴿مِنَ السَّماءِ﴾ attached to أنزل. ﴿ماءً﴾ mafʿūl bihi. ﴿فَأَخْرَجْنا﴾ the fāʾ is a conjunction, and أخرجنا is a past verb and its fāʿil (agent). ﴿بِهِ﴾ attached to أخرجنا. ﴿أَزْواجاً﴾ mafʿūl bihi. ﴿مِنْ نَباتٍ﴾ attached to an adjective (ṣifa) of أزواجا. ﴿شَتَّى﴾ an adjective of أزواجا; the clause أخرجنا etc. is conjoined. ﴿كُلُوا﴾ an imperative verb indeclinable (mabnī) on the deletion of the nūn; the wāw is the fāʿil; the clause is initial (ibtidāʾiyya). ﴿وَ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction. ﴿ارْعَوْا﴾ an imperative verb indeclinable on the deletion of the nūn; the wāw is the fāʿil. ﴿أَنْعامَكُمْ﴾ mafʿūl bihi; the kāf is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿إِنَّ﴾ a particle resembling the verb. ﴿فِي ذلِكَ﴾ attached to the fronted khabar; the lām is for distance and the kāf is for address. ﴿لَآياتٍ﴾ the lām is the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa), and آيات is the postponed noun of inna, accusative (manṣūb) by the kasra in place of the fatḥa because it is a sound feminine plural. ﴿لِأُولِي﴾ attached to an omitted adjective of آيات. ﴿النُّهى﴾ muḍāf ilayhi; the clause ﴿إِنَّ﴾ etc. is resumptive. ﴿مِنْها﴾ attached to خلقناكم. ﴿خَلَقْناكُمْ﴾ a past verb, its fāʿil and its object. ﴿وَ﴾ a conjunction. ﴿فِيها﴾ attached to نعيدكم. ﴿نُعِيدُكُمْ﴾ an imperfect verb and its object; its fāʿil is latent (mustatir). ﴿وَمِنْها﴾ attached to نخرجكم. ﴿نُخْرِجُكُمْ﴾ an imperfect verb and its object; its fāʿil is "نحن". ﴿تارَةً﴾ an adverb of time, attached to نخرجكم. ﴿أُخْرى﴾ an adjective; the clause is conjoined.

daas-irab:56-59.t:
﴿وَلَقَدْ﴾ the wāw is a preposition of oath, and it and what is sworn by are attached to (mutaʿalliq) the omitted verb of swearing; in ولقد the lām occurs in the answer of an omitted oath. ﴿قد﴾ a particle of realisation (taḥqīq). ﴿أَرَيْناهُ﴾ a past verb, its fāʿil (agent) and its first object. ﴿آياتِنا﴾ second mafʿūl bihi (direct object); nā is in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿كُلَّها﴾ tawkīd (emphasis) of آيات, accusative (manṣūb) by the fatḥa; the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿فَكَذَّبَ﴾ the fāʾ is a conjunction, and كذب — the clause is conjoined to أريناه. ﴿وَأَبى﴾ the clause is conjoined (maʿṭūfa). The signs that Allah gave our master Moses are nine signs: the hand, the staff, the flood, the locusts, the lice, the frogs, the blood, the years [of drought], and the shortage of fruits. Refer to the commentary on verse 101 of al-Isrāʾ in the Tafsīr of Ibn Kathīr or other commentaries. ﴿قالَ﴾ the clause is resumptive. ﴿أَجِئْتَنا﴾ a past verb, fāʿil and mafʿūl bihi; the clause is in the position of accusative as mafʿūl bihi of قال; the hamza is for rebuking interrogation (al-istifhām al-inkārī). ﴿لِتُخْرِجَنا﴾ the lām is for causation (taʿlīl), and تخرجنا is an accusative imperfect verb whose fāʿil is a latent (mustatir) pronoun; nā is in the position of accusative as mafʿūl bihi.
﴿مِنْ أَرْضِنا﴾ [a preposition and its genitive noun] attached to تخرجنا; nā is muḍāf ilayhi. The clause composed of an and what follows it is interpreted as a maṣdar (verbal noun) in the position of genitive by the lām, and both are attached to the verb before them. ﴿بِسِحْرِكَ﴾ attached to تخرجنا; the kāf is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿يا﴾ a vocative particle. ﴿مُوسى﴾ the one addressed (munādā). ﴿فَلَنَأْتِيَنَّكَ﴾ the fāʾ is the faṣīḥa fāʾ (al-fāʾ al-faṣīḥa), and the lām occurs in the answer of an implied (muqaddar) oath; نأتينك is an imperfect verb indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa because it is joined to the heavy nūn of emphasis; the fāʿil is a latent pronoun and the kāf is in the position of accusative as mafʿūl bihi. ﴿بِسِحْرٍ﴾ attached to نأتينك. ﴿مِثْلِهِ﴾ an adjective (ṣifa); the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi; the clause is the answer of the omitted oath. ﴿فَاجْعَلْ﴾ the fāʾ is a conjunction. ﴿اجعل﴾ an imperative verb whose fāʿil is latent. ﴿بَيْنَنا﴾ an adverb of time; nā is muḍāf ilayhi. [Translator's note: so in the source; بين is ordinarily classed as an adverb of place.] ﴿وَبَيْنَكَ﴾ conjoined to بيننا. ﴿مَوْعِداً﴾ first mafʿūl bihi of اجعل; the clause is conjoined. ﴿لا﴾ negative. ﴿نُخْلِفُهُ﴾ an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent; the hāʾ is mafʿūl bihi; the clause is an adjective of موعدا. ﴿نَحْنُ﴾ tawkīd of the latent pronoun in نخلفه. ﴿وَ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction. ﴿لا﴾ negative. ﴿أَنْتَ﴾ conjoined to the latent pronoun in نخلفه. ﴿مَكاناً﴾ second mafʿūl bihi. ﴿سُوىً﴾ an adjective of مكانا, accusative by the implied (muqaddara) fatḥa, i.e. "midway". ﴿قالَ﴾ the clause is resumptive. ﴿مَوْعِدُكُمْ﴾ mubtadaʾ (subject); the kāf is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿يَوْمُ﴾ khabar (predicate). ﴿الزِّينَةِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi; the clause is in the position of accusative as the maqūl al-qawl (object of the saying). ﴿وَأَنْ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction and an is a particle that makes the verb accusative. ﴿يُحْشَرَ﴾ a passive imperfect verb, accusative. ﴿النَّاسُ﴾ nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent). ﴿ضُحًى﴾ an adverb of time, attached to يحشر; the clause is conjoined.

daas-irab:60-61.t: ﴿فَتَوَلَّى﴾ the fāʾ is a conjunction, and a past verb. ﴿فِرْعَوْنُ﴾ fāʿil (agent). ﴿فَجَمَعَ﴾ a conjoined past verb; the fāʿil is latent (mustatir). ﴿كَيْدَهُ﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿ثُمَّ﴾ a conjunction indicating delay (tarākhī). ﴿أَتى﴾ a past verb whose fāʿil is latent; the clause is conjoined (maʿṭūfa). ﴿قالَ﴾ the clause is resumptive. ﴿لَهُمْ﴾ [a preposition and its genitive noun] attached to (mutaʿalliq) قال. ﴿مُوسى﴾ fāʿil. ﴿وَيْلَكُمْ﴾ mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) of an omitted verb which the Arabs let die out while keeping its maṣdar (verbal noun); the kāf is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿لا﴾ prohibitive. ﴿تَفْتَرُوا﴾ an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by lā by the deletion of the nūn; the wāw is the fāʿil. ﴿عَلَى اللَّهِ﴾ the Name of Majesty is genitive (majrūr) by على; [the two are] attached to تفتروا. ﴿كَذِباً﴾ mafʿūl bihi; the clause is the maqūl al-qawl (object of the saying). ﴿فَيُسْحِتَكُمْ﴾ the fāʾ is the fāʾ of causation (al-sababiyya), and an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by an implied (muḍmara) an after the fāʾ of causation; the fāʿil is latent and the kāf is mafʿūl bihi. ﴿بِعَذابٍ﴾ attached to يسحتكم. ﴿وَقَدْ﴾ the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya) and qad is a particle of realisation (taḥqīq); the clause ﴿خابَ﴾ is in the position of accusative as ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿مَنِ﴾ a relative, the fāʿil of خاب. ﴿افْتَرى﴾ a past verb whose fāʿil is latent; the clause has no grammatical position because it is the ṣila (relative clause).

daas-irab:62-64.t: ﴿فَتَنازَعُوا﴾ the fāʾ is a conjunction, and a past verb indeclinable (mabnī) on the ḍamma; the wāw is the fāʿil (agent). ﴿أَمْرَهُمْ﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿بَيْنَهُمْ﴾ an adverb attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial); the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi; the clause is conjoined (maʿṭūfa). ﴿وَأَسَرُّوا﴾ the wāw is a conjunction; the clause is conjoined. ﴿النَّجْوى﴾ mafʿūl bihi, accusative (manṣūb) by the implied (muqaddara) fatḥa. ﴿قالُوا﴾ the clause is resumptive. ﴿إِنْ﴾ lightened (mukhaffafa) from the heavy inna, with no governing effect. ﴿هذانِ﴾ a demonstrative in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿لَساحِرانِ﴾ the lām is the differentiating lām (al-lām al-fāriqa), and ساحران is the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ, nominative (marfūʿ) by the alif; the clause is in the position of accusative as the maqūl al-qawl (object of the saying). ﴿يُرِيدانِ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn; the wāw is the fāʿil; the clause is in the position of nominative as an adjective (ṣifa) of ساحران. [Translator's note: so in the source; the fāʿil of يريدان is the alif of the dual.] ﴿إِنْ﴾ making [the verb] accusative. [Translator's note: the source writes ﴿إِنْ﴾; the word in the verse is أَنْ.] ﴿يُخْرِجاكُمْ﴾ an imperfect verb, accusative by the deletion of the nūn; the alif is the fāʿil and the kāf is mafʿūl bihi; the clause is interpreted as a maṣdar (verbal noun) in the position of accusative as mafʿūl bihi of يريدان. ﴿مِنْ أَرْضِكُمْ﴾ [a preposition and its genitive noun] attached to يخرجاكم; the kāf is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿بِسِحْرِهِما﴾ attached to the verb before them. ﴿وَيَذْهَبا﴾ the wāw is a conjunction; the clause is conjoined to the clause يخرجاكم and is accusative like it. ﴿بِطَرِيقَتِكُمُ﴾ attached to يذهبا; the kāf is in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi and the mīm is for the plural. ﴿الْمُثْلى﴾ an adjective of طريقتكم, genitive (majrūr) by the implied kasra. ﴿فَأَجْمِعُوا﴾ the fāʾ is the faṣīḥa fāʾ (al-fāʾ al-faṣīḥa); an imperative verb indeclinable on the deletion of the nūn; the wāw is the fāʿil. ﴿كَيْدَكُمْ﴾ mafʿūl bihi, accusative; the kāf is muḍāf ilayhi; the clause has no grammatical position because it occurs as the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of a non-jussive condition, the implied form being "if the matter is … etc., then gather". ﴿ثُمَّ﴾ a conjunction. ﴿ائْتُوا﴾ an imperative verb indeclinable on the deletion of the nūn; the wāw is the fāʿil; the clause is conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿صَفًّا﴾ an accusative ḥāl, i.e. "lined up in ranks". ﴿وَقَدْ﴾ the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya); qad is a particle of realisation (taḥqīq). ﴿أَفْلَحَ﴾ a past verb. ﴿الْيَوْمَ﴾ an adverb of time. ﴿مَنِ﴾ a relative noun in the position of nominative as fāʿil; the clause is circumstantial. ﴿اسْتَعْلى﴾ a past verb indeclinable on the implied fatḥa; its fāʿil is latent (mustatir); the clause has no grammatical position because it is the ṣila (relative clause).

daas-irab:65-67.t: ﴿قالُوا﴾ the clause is initial (ibtidāʾiyya). ﴿يا﴾ a vocative particle. ﴿مُوسى﴾ the one addressed (munādā); the clause is in the position of accusative as the maqūl al-qawl (object of the saying). ﴿إِمَّا﴾ a particle of condition and detailing; its meaning here is choice (تخيير), with an omitted verb implied, "اختر" (choose). ﴿أَنْ﴾ making [the verb] accusative. ﴿تُلْقِيَ﴾ an accusative (manṣūb) imperfect verb whose fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir); an and what follows it are interpreted as a maṣdar (verbal noun) in the position of accusative as mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of the omitted verb اختر, the implied form being "choose one of the two matters". ﴿وَ﴾ a conjunction. ﴿إِمَّا﴾ a particle of condition and detailing. ﴿أَنْ﴾ making [the verb] accusative. ﴿نَكُونَ﴾ an incomplete (nāqiṣ) imperfect verb, and the wāw is its noun. [Translator's note: so in the source; there is no wāw in نكون — its noun is the latent pronoun نحن.] ﴿أَوَّلَ﴾ the accusative khabar (predicate) of نكون; the clause is conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿مَنْ﴾ a relative in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿أَلْقى﴾ the clause has no grammatical position because it is the ṣila (relative clause); an and what follows it are in the position of accusative as mafʿūl bihi of the omitted verb اختر. ﴿قالَ﴾ the clause is resumptive. ﴿بَلْ﴾ a particle of digression (iḍrāb). ﴿أَلْقُوا﴾ an imperative verb indeclinable (mabnī) on the deletion of the nūn; the wāw is the fāʿil; the clause is the maqūl al-qawl. ﴿فَإِذا﴾ the fāʾ is a conjunction, and إذا of surprise (al-fujāʾiyya). ﴿حِبالُهُمْ﴾ a nominative mubtadaʾ (subject); the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿وَ﴾ a conjunction. ﴿عِصِيُّهُمْ﴾ conjoined to حبالهم; the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi; the clause is initial. ﴿يُخَيَّلُ﴾ a passive imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by the ḍamma on its last letter; the clause is the khabar of the mubtadaʾ, and the nominal clause is genitive by annexation (iḍāfa). ﴿إِلَيْهِ﴾ [a preposition and its genitive noun] attached to (mutaʿalliq) يخيل. ﴿مِنْ سِحْرِهِمْ﴾ attached to يخيل; the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿أَنَّها﴾ anna and its noun; anna and what follows it are interpreted as a maṣdar serving as nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent). ﴿تَسْعى﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative by the implied (muqaddara) ḍamma; its fāʿil is latent; the clause is the khabar of anna. ﴿فَأَوْجَسَ﴾ the fāʾ is a conjunction; the clause of the verb أوجس and its fāʿil is conjoined. ﴿فِي نَفْسِهِ﴾ attached to أوجس; the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿خِيفَةً﴾ mafʿūl bihi. ﴿مُوسى﴾ a postponed fāʿil.

daas-irab:68-70.t: ﴿قُلْنا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil (agent); the clause is resumptive. ﴿لا﴾ prohibitive. ﴿تَخَفْ﴾ a jussive (majzūm) imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent (mustatir); the clause is in the position of accusative as mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of قلنا. ﴿إِنَّكَ﴾ inna and its noun. ﴿أَنْتَ﴾ tawkīd (emphasis) of the pronoun. ﴿الْأَعْلى﴾ the khabar (predicate) of inna; the clause is resumptive. ﴿وَ﴾ a conjunction. ﴿أَلْقِ﴾ an imperative verb indeclinable (mabnī) on the deletion of the weak letter; its fāʿil is latent; the clause is resumptive. ﴿ما﴾ a relative noun whose position is accusative as mafʿūl bihi. ﴿فِي يَمِينِكَ﴾ [a preposition and its genitive noun] attached to (mutaʿalliq) the omitted ṣila (relative clause) of mā; the kāf is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿تَلْقَفْ﴾ an imperfect verb, jussive because it is the answer to the request; its fāʿil is latent. ﴿ما﴾ a relative noun, mafʿūl bihi; the clause is resumptive. ﴿صَنَعُوا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause has no grammatical position because it is the ṣila. ﴿إن﴾ a particle resembling the verb. ﴿ما﴾ the relative [mā] is its noun; the clause is resumptive, with no position. ﴿صَنَعُوا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is the ṣila, with no position. ﴿كَيْدُ﴾ the khabar of inna. ﴿ساحِرٍ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿وَلا﴾ the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya) and lā is negative. ﴿يُفْلِحُ﴾ an imperfect verb. ﴿السَّاحِرُ﴾ fāʿil. ﴿حَيْثُ﴾ an adverb of place indeclinable on the ḍamma, attached to يفلح; the clause is in the position of accusative as ḥāl (circumstantial) — or the wāw is a conjunction and the clause is conjoined (maʿṭūfa). ﴿أَتى﴾ a past verb whose fāʿil is latent; the clause is in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿فَأُلْقِيَ﴾ the fāʾ is a conjunction, and ألقي is a passive past verb. ﴿السَّحَرَةُ﴾ nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent). ﴿سُجَّداً﴾ ḥāl; the clause is conjoined to an implied (muqaddara) clause, namely "Moses threw his staff, and the sorcerers were thrown down". ﴿قالُوا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is in the position of accusative as another ḥāl of السحرة. ﴿آمَنَّا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is in the position of accusative as the maqūl al-qawl (object of the saying). ﴿بِرَبِّ﴾ attached to آمنا. ﴿هارُونَ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi, genitive (majrūr) by the fatḥa because it is a diptote. ﴿وَمُوسى﴾ conjoined by the wāw, genitive like it, by the kasra implied on the alif maqṣūra owing to impossibility. [Translator's note: so in the source; موسى is likewise a diptote, so its implied genitive sign would be the fatḥa.]

daas-irab:71-71.t: ﴿قالَ﴾ the clause is resumptive. ﴿آمَنْتُمْ﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil (agent); the clause is the maqūl al-qawl (object of the saying). ﴿لَهُ﴾ [a preposition and its genitive noun] attached to (mutaʿalliq) آمنتم. ﴿قَبْلَ﴾ an adverb of time, attached to آمنتم. ﴿أَنْ﴾ making [the verb] accusative. ﴿آذَنَ﴾ an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by an; its fāʿil is latent (mustatir). ﴿لَكُمْ﴾ attached to آذن; the clause أن آذن is interpreted as a maṣdar (verbal noun) in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿إِنَّهُ﴾ inna and its noun. ﴿لَكَبِيرُكُمُ﴾ the lām is the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa), and كبيركم is the khabar (predicate) of inna; the kāf is muḍāf ilayhi; the clause is resumptive. ﴿الَّذِي﴾ a relative, an adjective (ṣifa) in the position of nominative. ﴿عَلَّمَكُمُ﴾ a past verb whose fāʿil is latent; the kāf is the first mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿السِّحْرَ﴾ second mafʿūl bihi; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause), with no position. ﴿فَلَأُقَطِّعَنَّ﴾ the fāʾ is the faṣīḥa fāʾ (al-fāʾ al-faṣīḥa), and the lām occurs in the answer of an omitted oath; أقطعن is an imperfect verb indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa because it is joined to the heavy nūn of emphasis; the nūn is a particle with no grammatical position; its fāʿil is latent. ﴿أَيْدِيَكُمْ﴾ mafʿūl bihi; the kāf is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿وَأَرْجُلَكُمْ﴾ conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿مِنْ خِلافٍ﴾ attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial), the meaning being "on opposite sides"; the clause has no position. ﴿وَلَأُصَلِّبَنَّكُمْ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction; the lām occurs in the answer of the oath, and the imperfect verb is indeclinable on the fatḥa because it is joined to the heavy nūn of emphasis; the fāʿil is latent and the kāf is in the position of accusative as mafʿūl bihi; the clause is conjoined (maʿṭūfa). ﴿فِي جُذُوعِ﴾ attached to أصلبنكم. ﴿النَّخْلِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿وَلَتَعْلَمُنَّ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and the lām occurs in the answer of the oath; the imperfect verb is nominative (marfūʿ), the sign of its nominative being the retention of the nūn — which was deleted because of the succession of like letters — since it is one of the five verbs; the wāw, deleted because of the meeting of two quiescent letters, is the fāʿil, and the nūn is the nūn of emphasis, with no position. ﴿أَيُّنا﴾ the interrogative ayy, in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject); nā is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿أَشَدُّ﴾ khabar; the clause is in the position of accusative, standing in place of the two objects of تعلمن, because the verb is suspended (ʿulliqa) by the interrogative ayy. ﴿عَذاباً﴾ tamyīz (specification). ﴿وَأَبْقى﴾ conjoined to أشد.

daas-irab:72-74.t: ﴿قالُوا﴾ the clause is resumptive. ﴿لَنْ﴾ making [the verb] accusative. ﴿نُؤْثِرَكَ﴾ an accusative (manṣūb) imperfect verb whose fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir), its implied form being "نحن"; the kāf is mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause is in the position of accusative as the maqūl al-qawl (object of the saying). ﴿عَلى﴾ a preposition. ﴿ما﴾ a relative noun; [the two are] attached to (mutaʿalliq) نؤثرك. ﴿جاءَنا﴾ a past verb whose fāʿil is latent; nā is mafʿūl bihi; the clause has no grammatical position because it is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿مِنَ الْبَيِّناتِ﴾ [a preposition and its genitive noun] attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿وَالَّذِي﴾ the wāw is a preposition of oath, and the relative noun is in the position of genitive; [the two are] attached to the omitted verb أقسم. ﴿فَطَرَنا﴾ a past verb whose fāʿil is latent; nā is mafʿūl bihi; the clause has no grammatical position because it is the ṣila of a relative. ﴿فَاقْضِ﴾ the fāʾ is the faṣīḥa fāʾ (al-fāʾ al-faṣīḥa), and اقض is an imperative verb indeclinable (mabnī) on the deletion of the weak letter; its fāʿil is latent. ﴿ما﴾ a relative noun, mafʿūl bihi. ﴿أَنْتَ﴾ mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿قاضٍ﴾ khabar (predicate), nominative (marfūʿ) by the ḍamma implied (muqaddara) on the deleted yāʾ because it is a defective noun (ism manqūṣ); the clause is the ṣila, with no position. ﴿إِنَّما﴾ the restraining [mā] and the restrained [inna] (kāffa wa-makfūfa). ﴿تَقْضِي﴾ an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent. ﴿هذِهِ﴾ a demonstrative, mafʿūl bihi. ﴿الْحَياةَ﴾ badal (substitute) of the demonstrative. ﴿الدُّنْيا﴾ an adjective (ṣifa); the clause has no grammatical position because it is causal (taʿlīliyya). ﴿إِنَّا﴾ inna and its noun. ﴿آمَنَّا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is the khabar of inna. ﴿بِرَبِّنا﴾ attached to آمنا; nā is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿لِيَغْفِرَ﴾ the lām is for causation (taʿlīl), and the imperfect verb is accusative by an implied (muḍmara) an after the lām of causation; the fāʿil is latent; an and what follows it are in the position of genitive by the lām, and both are attached to آمنا. ﴿لَنا﴾ attached to يغفر. ﴿خَطايانا﴾ an accusative mafʿūl bihi; nā is in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿وَ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction. ﴿ما﴾ a relative noun in the position of accusative, conjoined to خطايانا. ﴿أَكْرَهْتَنا﴾ a past verb, its fāʿil and its object. ﴿عَلَيْهِ﴾ attached to أكرهتنا; the clause has no grammatical position because it is the ṣila. ﴿مِنَ السِّحْرِ﴾ attached to an omitted ḥāl. ﴿وَاللَّهُ خَيْرٌ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and the mubtadaʾ and khabar are a conjoined clause. ﴿وَأَبْقى﴾ conjoined to خير in the nominative. ﴿إِنَّهُ﴾ inna and its noun. ﴿مَنْ﴾ a jussive conditional noun in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ. ﴿يَأْتِ﴾ an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by the deletion of the weak letter; its fāʿil is latent; it is the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ). ﴿رَبَّهُ﴾ mafʿūl bihi; the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿مُجْرِماً﴾ ḥāl. The clause of man is the khabar of inna, and the two clauses of the condition and the apodosis are the khabar of man. ﴿فَإِنَّ﴾ the fāʾ links the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ). ﴿إن﴾ a particle resembling the verb. ﴿لَهُ﴾ attached to the fronted khabar. ﴿جَهَنَّمَ﴾ its postponed noun; the clause is in the position of jussive as the apodosis, and the apodosis is joined with the linking fāʾ because the apodosis clause is a nominal clause. ﴿لا يَمُوتُ﴾ lā is negative, and the imperfect verb's fāʿil is latent. ﴿فِيها﴾ attached to يموت; the clause is circumstantial (ḥāliyya). ﴿وَلا يَحْيى﴾ the wāw is a conjunction and lā is negative; يحيا is an imperfect verb, nominative by the ḍamma implied on its last letter; the fāʿil is latent; the clause is conjoined (maʿṭūfa).

daas-irab:75-76.t: ﴿وَمَنْ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and man is a jussive conditional noun in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿يَأْتِهِ﴾ an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) because it is the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), by the deletion of the weak letter; the fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir) and the hāʾ is in the position of accusative as mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the two clauses of the condition and the apodosis are the khabar (predicate). ﴿مُؤْمِناً﴾ ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿قَدْ﴾ a particle of realisation (taḥqīq). ﴿عَمِلَ﴾ a past verb whose fāʿil is latent. ﴿الصَّالِحاتِ﴾ mafʿūl bihi, accusative (manṣūb) by the kasra because it is a sound feminine plural; the clause is an adjective (ṣifa) of مؤمنا. ﴿فَأُولئِكَ﴾ the fāʾ links the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); أولئك is mubtadaʾ. ﴿لَهُمُ﴾ [a preposition and its genitive noun] attached to (mutaʿalliq) the fronted khabar. ﴿الدَّرَجاتُ﴾ a postponed mubtadaʾ; the clause is in the position of nominative as the khabar of أولئك, and the clause أولئك is in the position of jussive as the apodosis. ﴿الْعُلى﴾ an adjective of الدرجات. ﴿جَنَّاتُ﴾ badal (substitute) of الدرجات. ﴿عَدْنٍ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿تَجْرِي﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by the implied (muqaddara) ḍamma. ﴿مِنْ تَحْتِهَا﴾ attached to تجري; the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿الْأَنْهارُ﴾ fāʿil. ﴿خالِدِينَ﴾ ḥāl, accusative by the yāʾ. ﴿فِيها﴾ attached to خالدين; the clause تجري is an adjective of جنات. ﴿وَ﴾ a conjunction. ﴿ذلِكَ﴾ a demonstrative, mubtadaʾ. ﴿جَزاءُ﴾ khabar. ﴿مِنْ﴾ a relative noun, muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿تَزَكَّى﴾ an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause), with no position; the clause of the mubtadaʾ and khabar is conjoined (maʿṭūfa). [Translator's note: so in the source; تزكى here is a past verb.]

daas-irab:77-79.t: ﴿وَلَقَدْ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, the lām occurs in the answer of an omitted oath, and qad is a particle of realisation (taḥqīq). ﴿أَوْحَيْنا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil (agent). ﴿إِلى مُوسى﴾ [a preposition and its genitive noun] attached to (mutaʿalliq) أوحينا; the clause is conjoined (maʿṭūfa). ﴿أَنْ﴾ explicative (mufassira). ﴿أَسْرِ﴾ an imperative verb indeclinable (mabnī) on the deletion of the weak letter; its fāʿil is latent (mustatir). ﴿بِعِبادِي﴾ attached to أسر; the yāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the clause has no grammatical position because it is explicative. ﴿فَاضْرِبْ﴾ the fāʾ is a conjunction; the clause is conjoined; the meaning is "make". ﴿لَهُمْ﴾ attached to اضرب, and the two stand in place of the second object. ﴿طَرِيقاً﴾ first mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿فِي الْبَحْرِ﴾ an adjective (ṣifa) of طريقا. ﴿يَبَساً﴾ a second adjective. ﴿لا تَخافُ﴾ lā is negative, and the imperfect verb's fāʿil is latent. ﴿دَرَكاً﴾ mafʿūl bihi; the clause is resumptive. ﴿وَلا تَخْشى﴾ the clause is conjoined. ﴿فَأَتْبَعَهُمْ﴾ the fāʾ is resumptive; أتبعهم is a past verb, and the hāʾ is a fronted mafʿūl bihi. ﴿فِرْعَوْنُ﴾ a postponed fāʿil. ﴿بِجُنُودِهِ﴾ attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial); the clause is resumptive. ﴿فَغَشِيَهُمْ﴾ the fāʾ is a conjunction; غشيهم is a past verb, and the hāʾ is mafʿūl bihi. ﴿مِنَ الْيَمِّ﴾ attached to the verb. ﴿ما﴾ a relative noun whose position is nominative as fāʿil; the clause is conjoined. ﴿غَشِيَهُمْ﴾ the clause is the ṣila (relative clause), with no position. ﴿وَأَضَلَّ فِرْعَوْنُ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and a past verb and its fāʿil. ﴿قَوْمَهُ﴾ mafʿūl bihi; the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi; the clause is conjoined. ﴿وَما﴾ the wāw is a conjunction and mā is negative. ﴿هَدى﴾ a past verb indeclinable on the implied (muqaddara) fatḥa; its fāʿil is latent; the clause is conjoined.

daas-irab:80-81.t: ﴿يا﴾ a vocative particle. ﴿بَنِي﴾ the one addressed (munādā), accusative (manṣūb) by the yāʾ because it is assimilated to the sound masculine plural. ﴿إِسْرائِيلَ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), genitive (majrūr) by the fatḥa in place of the kasra because it is a diptote. ﴿قَدْ﴾ a particle of realisation (taḥqīq). ﴿أَنْجَيْناكُمْ﴾ a past verb, its fāʿil (agent) and its object. ﴿مِنْ عَدُوِّكُمْ﴾ [a preposition and its genitive noun] attached to (mutaʿalliq) أنجيناكم; the clause is initial (ibtidāʾiyya). ﴿وَواعَدْناكُمْ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and a past verb, fāʿil and first mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿جانِبَ﴾ second mafʿūl bihi. ﴿الطُّورِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿الْأَيْمَنَ﴾ an adjective (ṣifa) of جانب; the clause is conjoined (maʿṭūfa). ﴿وَنَزَّلْنا﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and نزلنا is a past verb and its fāʿil. ﴿عَلَيْكُمُ﴾ attached to نزلنا. ﴿الْمَنَّ﴾ mafʿūl bihi. ﴿وَالسَّلْوى﴾ conjoined to المن; the clause is conjoined. ﴿كُلُوا﴾ an imperative verb and its fāʿil; the alif is for separation. ﴿مِنْ طَيِّباتِ﴾ attached to كلوا. ﴿ما﴾ a relative in the position of accusative as mafʿūl bihi; the clause is in the position of accusative as mafʿūl bihi of an omitted verb, its implied form being "قال … etc.". ﴿رَزَقْناكُمْ﴾ a past verb, fāʿil and mafʿūl bihi; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause), with no grammatical position. ﴿وَلا﴾ the wāw is a conjunction and lā is prohibitive. ﴿تَطْغَوْا﴾ an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by the deletion of the nūn; the wāw is the fāʿil. ﴿فِيهِ﴾ attached to تطغوا; the clause is conjoined. ﴿فَيَحِلَّ﴾ the fāʾ is the fāʾ of causation (al-sababiyya), and يحل is an imperfect verb, accusative by an implied (muḍmara) an after the fāʾ of causation. ﴿عَلَيْكُمْ﴾ attached to يحل. ﴿غَضَبِي﴾ fāʿil, nominative (marfūʿ) by the ḍamma implied (muqaddara) on the letter before the yāʾ of the first person; the yāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿وَمَنْ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and man is conditional, in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿يَحْلِلْ﴾ an imperfect verb, jussive because it is the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ). ﴿عَلَيْهِ﴾ attached to يحلل. ﴿غَضَبِي﴾ fāʿil; the yāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi; the clause is conjoined. ﴿فَقَدْ﴾ the fāʾ links the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) and qad is a particle of realisation. ﴿هَوى﴾ a past verb indeclinable (mabnī) on the implied fatḥa; its fāʿil is latent (mustatir); the clause is in the position of jussive as the apodosis, and the two clauses of the condition and the apodosis are the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ.

daas-irab:82-84.t: ﴿وَإِنِّي﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and inna and its noun. ﴿لَغَفَّارٌ﴾ the lām is the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa); غفار is the khabar (predicate). ﴿لِمَنْ﴾ the lām is a preposition. ﴿من﴾ a relative noun. ﴿تابَ﴾ the clause has no grammatical position because it is the ṣila (relative clause); the clause إني is conjoined (maʿṭūfa). ﴿وَآمَنَ﴾ the clause is conjoined. ﴿وَعَمِلَ﴾ a past verb whose fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir). ﴿صالِحاً﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause is conjoined. ﴿ثُمَّ﴾ a conjunction. ﴿اهْتَدى﴾ a past verb whose fāʿil is latent; the clause is conjoined. ﴿وَما﴾ the wāw is resumptive; mā is an interrogative noun in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿أَعْجَلَكَ﴾ a past verb whose fāʿil is latent; the kāf is mafʿūl bihi; the clause is the khabar. ﴿عَنْ قَوْمِكَ﴾ [a preposition and its genitive noun] attached to (mutaʿalliq) أعجلك; the kāf is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿يا مُوسى﴾ yā is a vocative particle, and the one addressed (munādā). ﴿قالَ﴾ the clause is resumptive. ﴿هُمْ﴾ a detached pronoun in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ. ﴿أُولاءِ﴾ a demonstrative, khabar; the clause is in the position of accusative as the maqūl al-qawl (object of the saying). ﴿عَلى أَثَرِي﴾ attached to a second khabar. ﴿وَعَجِلْتُ﴾ the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya); عجلت is a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is conjoined. ﴿إِلَيْكَ﴾ attached to عجلت. ﴿رَبِّ﴾ the one addressed, with an omitted vocative particle, accusative; the yāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi; the clause is circumstantial. ﴿لِتَرْضى﴾ the lām is for causation (taʿlīl), and the imperfect verb is accusative (manṣūb) by an implied (muḍmara) an; the lām and what follows it are attached to ترضى. [Translator's note: so in the source; the lām and what follows it would be attached to عجلت.]

daas-irab:85-87.t: ﴿قالَ﴾ the clause is resumptive. ﴿فَإِنَّا﴾ the fāʾ is redundant (zāʾida); إنا is inna, and nā is its noun; the clause is the maqūl al-qawl (object of the saying). ﴿قَدْ﴾ a particle of realisation (taḥqīq). ﴿فَتَنَّا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil (agent). ﴿قَوْمَكَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the kāf is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the clause is the khabar (predicate) of inna. ﴿مِنْ بَعْدِكَ﴾ [a preposition and its genitive noun] attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) of قومك. ﴿وَأَضَلَّهُمُ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction; أضلهم is a past verb, and the hāʾ is mafʿūl bihi. ﴿السَّامِرِيُّ﴾ fāʿil; the clause is conjoined (maʿṭūfa). ﴿فَرَجَعَ﴾ the fāʾ is resumptive. ﴿رجع﴾ a past verb. ﴿مُوسى﴾ fāʿil. ﴿إِلى قَوْمِهِ﴾ attached to رجع; the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿غَضْبانَ﴾ ḥāl. ﴿أَسِفاً﴾ a second ḥāl; the clause is resumptive. ﴿قالَ﴾ the clause is resumptive. ﴿يا قَوْمِ﴾ yā is a vocative particle; قوم is the one addressed (munādā), annexed to the omitted yāʾ of the first person. ﴿أَلَمْ﴾ the hamza is an interrogative particle for rebuke (inkār), and lam makes [the verb] jussive. ﴿يَعِدْكُمْ﴾ a jussive (majzūm) imperfect verb; the kāf is mafʿūl bihi. ﴿رَبُّكُمْ﴾ fāʿil; the kāf is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿وَعْداً﴾ mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object). ﴿حَسَناً﴾ an adjective (ṣifa); the vocative clause and the one after it are the maqūl al-qawl. ﴿أَفَطالَ﴾ the hamza is for interrogation and the fāʾ is a conjunction; طال is a past verb. ﴿عَلَيْكُمُ﴾ attached to طال. ﴿الْعَهْدُ﴾ fāʿil; the clause is conjoined. ﴿أَمْ﴾ a conjunction. ﴿أَرَدْتُمْ﴾ a past verb and fāʿil; the clause is conjoined. ﴿أَنْ﴾ making [the verb] accusative. ﴿يَحِلَّ﴾ an accusative (manṣūb) imperfect verb. ﴿عَلَيْكُمُ﴾ attached to يحل. ﴿غَضَبٌ﴾ fāʿil. ﴿مِنْ رَبِّكُمْ﴾ attached to an adjective of غضب; an and what follows it are interpreted as a maṣdar (verbal noun) in the position of accusative as mafʿūl bihi of أردتم. ﴿فَأَخْلَفْتُمْ﴾ the fāʾ is a conjunction; أخلفتم is a past verb and its fāʿil. ﴿مَوْعِدِي﴾ mafʿūl bihi; the yāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi; the clause is conjoined. ﴿قالُوا﴾ the clause is resumptive. ﴿ما﴾ negative. ﴿أَخْلَفْنا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil. ﴿مَوْعِدَكَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi; the kāf is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿بِمَلْكِنا﴾ attached to أخلفنا; بملكنا means "by our power"; the clause is the maqūl al-qawl. ﴿وَلكِنَّا﴾ the wāw is a conjunction; lākinna and its noun; the clause is conjoined. ﴿حُمِّلْنا﴾ a passive past verb, and nā is nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); the clause is the khabar of lākinna. ﴿أَوْزاراً﴾ the second mafʿūl bihi of حملنا. ﴿مِنْ زِينَةِ﴾ attached to an adjective of أوزارا. ﴿الْقَوْمِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿فَقَذَفْناها﴾ the fāʾ is a conjunction, and a past verb, fāʿil and mafʿūl bihi; the clause is conjoined. ﴿فَكَذلِكَ﴾ the fāʾ is a conjunction and the kāf is a preposition. ﴿ذا﴾ a demonstrative; the lām is for distance and the kāf is for address; the demonstrative is in the position of genitive by the kāf, and both are attached to an omitted adjective of an omitted maṣdar, its implied form being "he threw a throwing being … etc.". ﴿أَلْقَى السَّامِرِيُّ﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is conjoined.

daas-irab:88-90.t: ﴿فَأَخْرَجَ﴾ the fāʾ is a conjunction, and أخرج is a past verb whose fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir). ﴿لَهُمْ﴾ [a preposition and its genitive noun] attached to (mutaʿalliq) أخرج. ﴿عِجْلًا﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿جَسَداً﴾ badal (substitute) of عجلا; the clause is conjoined (maʿṭūfa). ﴿لَهُ﴾ attached to a fronted khabar (predicate). ﴿خُوارٌ﴾ a postponed mubtadaʾ (subject); the clause is an adjective (ṣifa). ﴿فَقالُوا﴾ the fāʾ is a conjunction. ﴿قالوا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is conjoined. ﴿هذا﴾ mubtadaʾ. ﴿إِلهُكُمْ﴾ khabar; the kāf is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the clause is the maqūl al-qawl (object of the saying). ﴿وَإِلهُ﴾ conjoined to إلهكم. ﴿مُوسى﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿فَنَسِيَ﴾ the fāʾ is a conjunction, and the clause نسي is conjoined. ﴿أَفَلا﴾ the hamza is for interrogation, the fāʾ is a conjunction and lā is negative. ﴿يَرَوْنَ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by the retention of the nūn; the wāw is the fāʿil; the clause is conjoined. ﴿أن﴾ lightened (mukhaffafa) from the heavy [anna]; its noun is the pronoun of the matter (ḍamīr al-shaʾn), its implied form being "أنه". ﴿لا﴾ negative. ﴿يَرْجِعُ﴾ an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent. ﴿إِلَيْهِمْ﴾ attached to يرجع. ﴿قَوْلًا﴾ mafʿūl bihi; an and what follows it are interpreted as a maṣdar (verbal noun) in the position of accusative as mafʿūl bihi, and the clause يرجع is the khabar of an. ﴿وَلا﴾ the wāw is a conjunction and lā is negative. ﴿يَمْلِكُ﴾ an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent. ﴿لَهُمْ﴾ attached to يملك. ﴿ضَرًّا وَلا نَفْعاً﴾ ضرا is mafʿūl bihi and نفعا is conjoined to it; the clause is conjoined. ﴿وَلَقَدْ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, the lām is for the oath and qad is a particle of realisation (taḥqīq). ﴿قالَ لَهُمْ هارُونُ﴾ a past verb and fāʿil. ﴿مِنْ قَبْلُ﴾ attached to قال; the clause has no grammatical position because it is the answer of the oath. ﴿يا قَوْمِ﴾ yā is a vocative particle; قوم is the one addressed (munādā), annexed to the omitted yāʾ of the first person; the clause is the maqūl al-qawl. ﴿إِنَّما﴾ the restraining [mā] and the restrained [inna] (kāffa wa-makfūfa). ﴿فُتِنْتُمْ﴾ a passive past verb; the tāʾ is nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) and the mīm is the sign of the masculine plural. ﴿بِهِ﴾ attached to فتنتم; the clause is the maqūl al-qawl. ﴿وَإِنَّ رَبَّكُمُ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and inna and its noun; the kāf is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿الرَّحْمنُ﴾ khabar; the clause is conjoined. ﴿فَاتَّبِعُونِي﴾ the fāʾ is the faṣīḥa fāʾ (al-fāʾ al-faṣīḥa); اتبعوني is an imperative verb indeclinable (mabnī) on the deletion of the nūn; the nūn is for protection (wiqāya) and the yāʾ is mafʿūl bihi. ﴿وَأَطِيعُوا﴾ the clause is conjoined. ﴿أَمْرِي﴾ mafʿūl bihi, accusative (manṣūb) by the fatḥa implied (muqaddara) on the letter before the yāʾ of the first person, its appearance being prevented by the place being occupied by the vowel suited [to the yāʾ]; the clause is conjoined.

daas-irab:91-94.t:
﴿قالُوا﴾ the clause is initial (ibtidāʾiyya). ﴿لَنْ﴾ making [the verb] accusative. ﴿نَبْرَحَ﴾ an incomplete (nāqiṣ) imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by lan; its noun is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "نحن". ﴿عَلَيْهِ﴾ [a preposition and its genitive noun] attached to (mutaʿalliq) عاكفين. ﴿عاكِفِينَ﴾ the khabar (predicate) of نبرح; the clause is the maqūl al-qawl (object of the saying). ﴿حَتَّى﴾ a particle of limit and a preposition. ﴿يَرْجِعَ﴾ an imperfect verb, accusative by an implied (muḍmara) an after حتى. ﴿إِلَيْنا﴾ attached to يرجع. ﴿مُوسى﴾ fāʿil (agent). يرجع and the implied an before it are interpreted as a maṣdar (verbal noun) in the position of genitive by حتى, and [the two are] attached to عاكفين. ﴿قالَ﴾ the clause is resumptive. ﴿يا هارُونُ﴾ yā is a vocative particle, and the one addressed (munādā); the clause is in the position of accusative as mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of قال. ﴿ما﴾ an interrogative noun in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿مَنَعَكَ﴾ a past verb whose fāʿil is latent; the kāf is mafʿūl bihi; the clause is the khabar of mā. ﴿إِذْ﴾ an adverb attached to منعك. ﴿رَأَيْتَهُمْ﴾ a past verb, fāʿil and mafʿūl bihi; the clause is in the position of genitive by annexation (iḍāfa). ﴿ضَلُّوا﴾ a past verb and fāʿil; the clause is in the position of accusative as the second mafʿūl bihi of رأيتهم, on the view that it is [a verb] of the heart (qalbiyya). ﴿أن﴾ a maṣdar-forming particle that makes the verb accusative. ﴿لا﴾ redundant (zāʾida). ﴿تَتَّبِعَنِ﴾ an accusative imperfect verb; the nūn is for protection (wiqāya), the fāʿil is latent, and the deleted yāʾ is mafʿūl bihi; it was also read with the yāʾ retained. An and what follows it are interpreted as a maṣdar in the position of genitive by an implied preposition, min, and [the two are] attached to the verb. ﴿أَفَعَصَيْتَ﴾ the hamza is for rebuking interrogation (al-istifhām al-inkārī), the fāʾ is a conjunction, and عصيت is a past verb and its fāʿil. ﴿أَمْرِي﴾ mafʿūl bihi; the yāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the clause is conjoined to an omitted, implied clause.
[Translator's note: from this point the source text is damaged — the brackets around the Quranic cue words are corrupted and several words are truncated. The cue words below are restored from the verse (20:94); the analyses are translated as they stand.]
﴿قالَ﴾ the clause is resumptive. ﴿يا﴾ a vocative particle. ﴿بْنَ أُمَّ﴾ two nouns compounded together, indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa, in the position of accusative as the one addressed. ﴿لا﴾ prohibitive. ﴿تَأْخُذْ﴾ a jussive (majzūm) imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent. ﴿بِلِحْيَتِي﴾ attached to تأخذ. ﴿وَلا﴾ the wāw is a conjunction and lā is prohibitive, entering upon an omitted verb. ﴿بِرَأْسِي﴾ attached to تأخذ, and it is conjoined; the vocative clause and what follows it are the maqūl al-qawl. ﴿إِنِّي﴾ inna and its noun; the clause is causal (taʿlīliyya). ﴿خَشِيتُ﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is the khabar of inna. ﴿أَنْ﴾ making [the verb] accusative. ﴿تَقُولَ﴾ an accusative imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent; the clause is a khabar. ﴿فَرَّقْتَ﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil. ﴿بَيْنَ﴾ an adverb of place. ﴿بَنِي﴾ muḍāf ilayhi, genitive (majrūr) by the yāʾ. ﴿إِسْرائِيلَ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi, genitive by the fatḥa because it is a diptote; the clause is the maqūl al-qawl. ﴿وَلَمْ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction and lam makes [the verb] jussive. ﴿تَرْقُبْ﴾ an imperfect verb, jussive by it; its fāʿil is latent. ﴿قَوْلِي﴾ mafʿūl bihi; the yāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi; the clause is conjoined (maʿṭūfa).

daas-irab:95-96.t: ﴿قالَ﴾ the clause is resumptive. ﴿فَما﴾ the fāʾ is redundant (zāʾida); mā is an interrogative noun in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿خَطْبُكَ﴾ khabar (predicate); the kāf is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿يا سامِرِيُّ﴾ yā is a vocative particle, and سامري is the one addressed (munādā), indeclinable (mabnī) on the ḍamma in the position of accusative; the nominal clause and the vocative are in the position of accusative as the maqūl al-qawl (object of the saying). ﴿قالَ﴾ the clause is resumptive. ﴿بَصُرْتُ﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil (agent). ﴿بِما﴾ the preposition and the relative mā are attached to (mutaʿalliq) بصرت; the clause is the maqūl al-qawl. ﴿لَمْ﴾ making [the verb] jussive. ﴿يَبْصُرُوا﴾ an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by the deletion of the nūn; the wāw is the fāʿil; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause), with no position. ﴿بِهِ﴾ attached to يبصروا. ﴿فَقَبَضْتُ﴾ the fāʾ is a conjunction, and قبضت is a past verb and its fāʿil. ﴿قَبْضَةً﴾ mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object). ﴿مِنْ أَثَرِ﴾ attached to قبضت. ﴿الرَّسُولِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. The trace of the messenger is the trace of the hoof of the horse of our master Gabriel, peace be upon him. The clause is conjoined (maʿṭūfa). ﴿فَنَبَذْتُها﴾ the fāʾ is a conjunction, and a past verb, its fāʿil and its object; the clause is conjoined. ﴿وَكَذلِكَ﴾ the wāw is resumptive, and the preposition and the genitive demonstrative are attached to an omitted adjective (ṣifa) of an omitted mafʿūl muṭlaq, its implied form being "my soul enticed me with an enticement like that enticement … etc.". ﴿سَوَّلَتْ﴾ a past verb; the tāʾ is for the feminine. ﴿لِي﴾ attached to سولت. ﴿نَفْسِي﴾ fāʿil; the yāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi; the clause is resumptive.

daas-irab:97-97.t: ﴿قالَ﴾ the clause is resumptive. ﴿فَاذْهَبْ﴾ the fāʾ is a conjunction, and the imperative verb's fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir); the clause is conjoined (maʿṭūfa). ﴿فَإِنَّ﴾ the fāʾ is a conjunction and inna is a particle resembling the verb. ﴿لَكَ﴾ [a preposition and its genitive noun] attached to (mutaʿalliq) the khabar (predicate). ﴿فِي الْحَياةِ﴾ attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿أَنْ﴾ making [the verb] accusative. ﴿تَقُولَ﴾ an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent; the interpreted maṣdar is in the position of accusative as the noun of inna. ﴿لا﴾ the lā of generic negation. ﴿مِساسَ﴾ the noun of lā; the khabar is omitted; the clause is in the position of accusative as the maqūl al-qawl (object of the saying). It is said that al-Sāmirī was afflicted with an illness resembling gout, so that anything that touched him hurt him, and that was a punishment for him in this world. ﴿وَإِنَّ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction and inna is a particle resembling the verb. ﴿لَكَ﴾ attached to the fronted khabar. ﴿مَوْعِداً﴾ its postponed noun. ﴿لَنْ﴾ making [the verb] accusative. ﴿تُخْلَفَهُ﴾ a passive imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb); the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) is latent and the hāʾ is mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause is in the position of accusative as an adjective (ṣifa) of موعدا. ﴿وَانْظُرْ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and انظر is an imperative verb whose fāʿil is latent. ﴿إِلى إِلهِكَ﴾ attached to انظر. ﴿الَّذِي﴾ a relative in the position of genitive as an adjective; the clause is conjoined. ﴿ظَلْتَ﴾ an incomplete (nāqiṣ) past verb; its original form is ظللت, the lām being deleted for lightening; the tāʾ is its noun. ﴿عَلَيْهِ﴾ attached to عاكفا. ﴿عاكِفاً﴾ khabar; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative, with no position. ﴿لَنُحَرِّقَنَّهُ﴾ the lām prepares for the oath (muwaṭṭiʾa lil-qasam), and نحرقنه is an imperfect verb indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa because it is joined to the heavy nūn of emphasis; its fāʿil is latent and the hāʾ is mafʿūl bihi; the clause has no grammatical position because it is the answer of the oath. ﴿ثُمَّ﴾ a conjunction. ﴿لَنَنْسِفَنَّهُ﴾ the clause is conjoined. ﴿فِي الْيَمِّ﴾ attached to the verb before them. ﴿نَسْفاً﴾ mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object).

daas-irab:98-100.t: ﴿إِنَّما﴾ the restraining [mā] and the restrained [inna] (kāffa wa-makfūfa). ﴿إِلهُكُمُ﴾ mubtadaʾ (subject); the kāf is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿اللَّهُ﴾ the Name of Majesty, khabar (predicate); the clause is resumptive. ﴿الَّذِي﴾ a relative in the position of nominative as an adjective (ṣifa). ﴿لا﴾ the lā of generic negation. ﴿إِلهَ﴾ its noun; the khabar is omitted, its implied form being "موجود". ﴿إِلَّا﴾ a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr). ﴿هُوَ﴾ badal (substitute) of the pronoun implied in the khabar; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause), with no position. ﴿وَسِعَ﴾ a past verb whose fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir). ﴿كُلَّ﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿شَيْءٍ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿عِلْماً﴾ tamyīz (specification); the clause is resumptive. ﴿كَذلِكَ﴾ the preposition and the demonstrative are attached to (mutaʿalliq) an adjective of an omitted mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), its implied form being "We relate to you a relating like that which We have related to you". ﴿نَقُصُّ﴾ an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent; the clause is initial (ibtidāʾiyya). ﴿عَلَيْكَ﴾ attached to نقص. ﴿مِنْ أَنْباءِ﴾ attached to the verb نقص. ﴿ما﴾ a relative, muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿قَدْ سَبَقَ﴾ the clause is the ṣila, with no position. ﴿وَقَدْ﴾ the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya); qad is a particle of realisation (taḥqīq). ﴿آتَيْناكَ﴾ a past verb, fāʿil and first mafʿūl bihi; the clause is circumstantial. ﴿مِنْ لَدُنَّا﴾ attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) of ذكرا. ﴿ذِكْراً﴾ second mafʿūl bihi. ﴿مَنْ﴾ a jussive conditional noun in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ. ﴿أَعْرَضَ﴾ a past verb whose fāʿil is latent, in the position of jussive as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ). ﴿عَنْهُ﴾ attached to أعرض; the clause is conjoined (maʿṭūfa). ﴿فَإِنَّهُ﴾ the fāʾ is linking, and inna and its noun; the clause ﴿يَحْمِلُ﴾ is its khabar, and the clause فإنه is in the position of jussive as the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ). ﴿يَوْمَ﴾ an adverb of time. ﴿الْقِيامَةِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿وِزْراً﴾ mafʿūl bihi; the two clauses of the condition are the khabar of man.

daas-irab:101-104.t: ﴿خالِدِينَ﴾ ḥāl (circumstantial), accusative (manṣūb) by the yāʾ. ﴿فِيهِ﴾ [a preposition and its genitive noun] attached to (mutaʿalliq) خالدين. ﴿وَساءَ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction; ساء is a past verb whose fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir), and ساء is one of the verbs of blame. ﴿لَهُمْ﴾ attached to ساء. ﴿يَوْمَ﴾ an adverb of time, attached to حملا. ﴿الْقِيامَةِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿حِمْلًا﴾ tamyīz (specification); the clause is conjoined (maʿṭūfa). ﴿يَوْمَ﴾ badal (substitute) of يوم القيامة. ﴿يُنْفَخُ﴾ a passive imperfect verb whose nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) is latent; the clause is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿فِي الصُّورِ﴾ attached to ينفخ. ﴿وَنَحْشُرُ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and the imperfect verb's fāʿil is latent, its implied form being "نحن". ﴿الْمُجْرِمِينَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause is conjoined. ﴿يَوْمَئِذٍ﴾ an adverb annexed to an adverb, attached to نحشر. ﴿زُرْقاً﴾ ḥāl, i.e. from the effect of the punishment. ﴿يَتَخافَتُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by the retention of the nūn; the wāw is the fāʿil; the clause is a ḥāl. ﴿بَيْنَهُمْ﴾ an adverb attached to the verb before it. ﴿إِنْ﴾ negative. ﴿لَبِثْتُمْ﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil. ﴿إِلَّا﴾ a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr). ﴿عَشْراً﴾ an adverb of time, attached to لبثتم; the clause is interpreted as a maṣdar (verbal noun) in the position of accusative as mafʿūl bihi of an omitted saying, its implied form being "قائلين" (saying). ﴿نَحْنُ﴾ mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿أَعْلَمُ﴾ khabar (predicate). ﴿بِما﴾ the preposition and the relative noun are attached to أعلم; the clause is resumptive. ﴿يَقُولُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn; the wāw is the fāʿil; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause), with no position. ﴿إِذْ﴾ an adverb attached to أعلم. ﴿يَقُولُ﴾ the clause is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿أَمْثَلُهُمْ﴾ fāʿil; the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿طَرِيقَةً﴾ tamyīz. ﴿إِنْ﴾ negative. ﴿لَبِثْتُمْ﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil. ﴿إِلَّا﴾ a particle of restriction. ﴿يَوْماً﴾ an adverb attached to لبثتم.

daas-irab:105-108.t: ﴿وَيَسْئَلُونَكَ﴾ the wāw is resumptive; يسألون is an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by the retention of the nūn; the wāw is the fāʿil (agent) and the kāf is mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause is resumptive. ﴿عَنِ الْجِبالِ﴾ [a preposition and its genitive noun] attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb. ﴿فَقُلْ﴾ the fāʾ is a conjunction, and قل is an imperative verb whose fāʿil is latent (mustatir); the clause is conjoined (maʿṭūfa). ﴿يَنْسِفُها﴾ a nominative imperfect verb; the hāʾ is in the position of accusative as mafʿūl bihi. ﴿رَبِّي﴾ a postponed fāʿil; the yāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿نَسْفاً﴾ mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object); the clause is in the position of accusative as the maqūl al-qawl (object of the saying). ﴿فَيَذَرُها﴾ the fāʾ is a conjunction, and the imperfect verb's fāʿil is latent; the hāʾ is in the position of accusative as mafʿūl bihi; the clause is conjoined. ﴿قاعاً﴾ ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿صَفْصَفاً﴾ a second ḥāl. ﴿لا﴾ negative. ﴿تَرى﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative by the implied (muqaddara) ḍamma; its fāʿil is latent. ﴿فِيها﴾ attached to ترى. ﴿عِوَجاً﴾ mafʿūl bihi. ﴿وَلا﴾ the wāw is a conjunction. ﴿لا﴾ negative. ﴿أَمْتاً﴾ conjoined to عوجا. ﴿يَوْمَئِذٍ﴾ يوم is an adverb attached to يتبعون, and idh is an adverb, muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿يَتَّبِعُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn; the wāw is the fāʿil. ﴿الدَّاعِيَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi, accusative (manṣūb) by the fatḥa; the clause is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿لا﴾ the lā of generic negation. ﴿عِوَجَ﴾ the noun of lā. ﴿لَهُ﴾ attached to the omitted khabar (predicate); the clause is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl of الداعي. ﴿وَخَشَعَتِ﴾ the wāw is resumptive, and a past verb; the tāʾ is for the feminine. ﴿الْأَصْواتُ﴾ fāʿil. ﴿لِلرَّحْمنِ﴾ attached to خشعت; the clause is resumptive. ﴿فَلا﴾ the fāʾ is a conjunction. ﴿لا﴾ negative. ﴿تَسْمَعُ﴾ an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent. ﴿إِلَّا﴾ a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr). ﴿هَمْساً﴾ mafʿūl bihi of تسمع; the clause is conjoined.

daas-irab:109-111.t: ﴿يوم﴾ an adverb attached to (mutaʿalliq) تنفع. ﴿إذ﴾ an adverb, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿لا﴾ negative. ﴿تَنْفَعُ الشَّفاعَةُ﴾ an imperfect verb and its fāʿil (agent). ﴿إِلَّا﴾ a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr). ﴿مَنْ﴾ a relative noun, mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿أَذِنَ﴾ a past verb. ﴿لَهُ﴾ [a preposition and its genitive noun] attached to the verb. ﴿الرَّحْمنُ﴾ fāʿil; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause), with no position. ﴿وَرَضِيَ﴾ the clause is conjoined (maʿṭūfa). ﴿لَهُ﴾ attached to رضي. ﴿قَوْلًا﴾ mafʿūl bihi. ﴿يَعْلَمُ﴾ a nominative (marfūʿ) imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent (mustatir). ﴿ما﴾ a relative noun, mafʿūl bihi. ﴿بَيْنَ﴾ an adverb of place, attached to an omitted ṣila. ﴿أَيْدِيهِمْ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi; the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi; the clause is resumptive. ﴿وَما خَلْفَهُمْ﴾ the clause is conjoined. ﴿وَلا﴾ the wāw is a conjunction and lā is negative. ﴿يُحِيطُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn; the wāw is the fāʿil; the clause is conjoined. ﴿بِهِ﴾ attached to يحيطون. ﴿عِلْماً﴾ mafʿūl bihi. ﴿وَعَنَتِ﴾ the wāw is resumptive, and عنت is a past verb; the tāʾ is for the feminine. ﴿الْوُجُوهُ﴾ fāʿil; the clause is resumptive. ﴿لِلْحَيِّ﴾ attached to عنت. ﴿الْقَيُّومِ﴾ an adjective (ṣifa). ﴿وَقَدْ خابَ﴾ the clause is circumstantial (ḥāliyya). ﴿مَنْ﴾ a relative noun, fāʿil. ﴿حَمَلَ﴾ the clause is the ṣila, with no position. ﴿ظُلْماً﴾ mafʿūl bihi.

daas-irab:112-113.t:
﴿وَمَنْ﴾ the wāw is a resumptive particle, and man is a jussive conditional noun in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject); the clause is resumptive. ﴿يَعْمَلْ﴾ an imperfect verb whose fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir); يعمل is the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ). ﴿مِنَ الصَّالِحاتِ﴾ [a preposition and its genitive noun] attached to (mutaʿalliq) يعمل. ﴿وَهُوَ مُؤْمِنٌ﴾ the wāw is the wāw of circumstance (ḥāl), and mubtadaʾ and khabar (predicate); the clause is circumstantial (ḥāliyya). ﴿فَلا﴾ the fāʾ links the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); lā is negative. ﴿يَخافُ﴾ an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent. ﴿ظُلْماً﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿وَلا هَضْماً﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and هضما is conjoined to ظلما; the clause is in the position of jussive as the apodosis, and the two clauses of the condition are the khabar of the mubtadaʾ man. ﴿وَكَذلِكَ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, the kāf is a preposition, and ذا is a demonstrative in the position of genitive — the lām is for distance and the kāf is for address — [the two being] attached to an omitted adjective (ṣifa) of a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), its implied form being "We sent it down a sending down being like … etc.".
﴿أَنْزَلْناهُ﴾ a past verb, its fāʿil and its object. ﴿قُرْآناً﴾ ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿عَرَبِيًّا﴾ an adjective; the clause is conjoined (maʿṭūfa). ﴿وَصَرَّفْنا﴾ the wāw is a conjunction; صرفنا is a past verb and its fāʿil. ﴿فِيهِ﴾ attached to صرفنا. ﴿مِنَ الْوَعِيدِ﴾ the preposition and its genitive noun are an adjective of an omitted mafʿūl bihi, its implied form being "We varied a threat from among the threats"; the clause ﴿صَرَّفْنا﴾ is conjoined. ﴿لَعَلَّهُمْ﴾ لعل and its noun. ﴿يَتَّقُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by the retention of the nūn; the wāw is the fāʿil; the clause is the khabar. ﴿أَوْ﴾ a conjunction. ﴿يُحْدِثُ﴾ an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent, referring back to the Qur'an. ﴿لَهُمْ﴾ attached to يحدث. ﴿ذِكْراً﴾ mafʿūl bihi; the clause is conjoined.

daas-irab:114-115.t: ﴿فَتَعالَى﴾ the fāʾ is resumptive; تعالى is a past verb indeclinable (mabnī) on the implied (muqaddara) fatḥa. ﴿اللَّهُ﴾ the Name of Majesty, fāʿil (agent). ﴿الْمَلِكُ الْحَقُّ﴾ two nominative adjectives (ṣifa); the clause is resumptive. ﴿وَلا﴾ the wāw is a conjunction and lā is prohibitive. ﴿تَعْجَلْ﴾ an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by the prohibitive lā; its fāʿil is latent (mustatir). ﴿بِالْقُرْآنِ﴾ [a preposition and its genitive noun] attached to (mutaʿalliq) تعجل. ﴿مِنْ قَبْلِ﴾ attached to تعجل. ﴿أَنْ﴾ making [the verb] accusative. ﴿يُقْضى﴾ a passive imperfect verb. ﴿إِلَيْكَ﴾ attached to يقضى. ﴿وَحْيُهُ﴾ nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿وَقُلْ﴾ the clause is conjoined (maʿṭūfa). ﴿رَبِّ﴾ the one addressed (munādā) with an omitted vocative particle; it is accusative as a vocative and annexed to the omitted yāʾ of the first person. ﴿زِدْنِي﴾ a verb of supplication; the nūn is for protection (wiqāya) and the yāʾ is in the position of accusative as the first mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿عِلْماً﴾ second mafʿūl bihi; the vocative clause and the one after it are the maqūl al-qawl (object of the saying). ﴿وَلَقَدْ﴾ the wāw is resumptive, the lām occurs in the answer of an omitted oath, and qad is a particle of realisation (taḥqīq). ﴿عَهِدْنا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil. ﴿إِلى آدَمَ﴾ attached to عهدنا. ﴿مِنْ﴾ a preposition; qabl is an adverb indeclinable on the ḍamma in the position of genitive; [the two are] attached to عهدنا or to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial); the clause is resumptive. ﴿فَنَسِيَ﴾ the clause is conjoined by the fāʾ. ﴿وَلَمْ نَجِدْ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction and lam is a jussive particle; نجد is a jussive imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent. ﴿لَهُ﴾ attached to نجد. ﴿عَزْماً﴾ mafʿūl bihi; the clause is conjoined.

daas-irab:116-117.t: ﴿وَإِذْ﴾ the wāw is resumptive; idh is an adverb attached to (mutaʿalliq) [an implied] اذكر. ﴿قُلْنا﴾ the clause is in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿لِلْمَلائِكَةِ﴾ [a preposition and its genitive noun] attached to قلنا. ﴿اسْجُدُوا﴾ an imperative verb indeclinable (mabnī) on the deletion of the nūn; the wāw is the fāʿil (agent). ﴿لِآدَمَ﴾ the lām is a preposition; آدم is genitive (majrūr) by the fatḥa in place of the kasra because it is a diptote; the clause is the maqūl al-qawl (object of the saying). ﴿فَسَجَدُوا﴾ the fāʾ is a conjunction; the clause is conjoined (maʿṭūfa). ﴿إِلَّا﴾ a particle of exception. ﴿إِبْلِيسَ﴾ excepted by إلا, accusative (manṣūb) by the fatḥa. ﴿أَبى﴾ a past verb indeclinable on the implied (muqaddara) fatḥa; its fāʿil is latent (mustatir); the clause is in the position of accusative as ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿فَقُلْنا﴾ the fāʾ is resumptive, and قلنا is a past verb and fāʿil; the clause is resumptive. ﴿يا آدَمُ﴾ yā is a vocative particle; آدم is the one addressed (munādā), a singular proper noun, indeclinable on the ḍamma, in the position of accusative as mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of أدعو. ﴿إِنَّ﴾ a particle resembling the verb. ﴿هذا﴾ the hāʾ is for drawing attention (tanbīh), and ذا is a demonstrative in the position of accusative as the noun of inna. ﴿عَدُوٌّ﴾ khabar (predicate). ﴿لَكَ﴾ attached to عدو. ﴿وَلِزَوْجِكَ﴾ conjoined to what precedes it; the kāf is in the position of genitive by annexation (iḍāfa); the two clauses are the maqūl al-qawl. ﴿فَلا﴾ the fāʾ is a conjunction and lā is prohibitive. ﴿يُخْرِجَنَّكُما﴾ an imperfect verb indeclinable on the fatḥa because it is joined to the heavy nūn of emphasis, in the position of jussive by lā; its fāʿil is latent and the kāf is in the position of accusative as mafʿūl bihi. ﴿مِنَ الْجَنَّةِ﴾ attached to يخرجنكما; the clause is conjoined. ﴿فَتَشْقى﴾ the fāʾ is the fāʾ of causation (al-sababiyya), and تشقى is an imperfect verb, accusative by an implied (muḍmara) an after the fāʾ of causation; its fāʿil is latent; the implied an and the verb are interpreted as a maṣdar (verbal noun) conjoined to what precedes it.

daas-irab:118-120.t: ﴿إِنَّ﴾ a particle resembling the verb. ﴿لَكَ﴾ [a preposition and its genitive noun] attached to (mutaʿalliq) the fronted khabar (predicate). ﴿إِنَّ﴾ a particle that makes the verb accusative. [Translator's note: the source writes ﴿إِنَّ﴾ here; the word in the verse is the an of أَلَّا (an + lā).] ﴿لا﴾ negative. ﴿تَجُوعَ﴾ an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by an. ﴿فِيها﴾ attached to تجوع; the clause made of an and what follows it is interpreted as a maṣdar (verbal noun) in the position of accusative as the postponed noun of inna. ﴿وَلا﴾ the wāw is a conjunction and lā is negative. ﴿تَعْرى﴾ conjoined to تجوع, accusative by the implied (muqaddara) fatḥa; the clause is conjoined (maʿṭūfa). ﴿وَأَنَّكَ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and anna and its noun. ﴿لا تَظْمَؤُا﴾ lā is negative; تظمأ is an imperfect verb whose fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir); the clause is the khabar of anna; anna, its noun and its khabar are interpreted as a maṣdar conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿فَوَسْوَسَ﴾ the fāʾ is a conjunction; وسوس is a past verb. ﴿إِلَيْهِ﴾ attached to وسوس. ﴿الشَّيْطانُ﴾ fāʿil; the clause is conjoined. ﴿قالَ﴾ the clause is explicative (tafsīriyya), with no position. ﴿يا آدَمُ﴾ yā is a vocative particle, and آدم is the one addressed (munādā), indeclinable (mabnī) on the ḍamma; the clause is the maqūl al-qawl (object of the saying). ﴿هَلْ﴾ an interrogative particle. ﴿أَدُلُّكَ﴾ an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent; the kāf is in the position of accusative as mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿عَلى شَجَرَةِ﴾ attached to أدلك. ﴿الْخُلْدِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the clause is the maqūl al-qawl. ﴿وَمُلْكٍ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction; ملك is conjoined to شجرة الخلد. ﴿لا يَبْلى﴾ lā is negative; يبلى is an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by the ḍamma implied on its last letter; its fāʿil is latent; the clause is in the position of genitive as an adjective (ṣifa) of ملك.

daas-irab:121-123.t: ﴿فَأَكَلا﴾ the fāʾ is resumptive, and أكلا is a past verb indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa; the alif is the fāʿil (agent). ﴿مِنْها﴾ [a preposition and its genitive noun] attached to (mutaʿalliq) أكلا; the clause is resumptive. ﴿فَبَدَتْ﴾ the fāʾ is a conjunction, and بدت is a past verb; the tāʾ is the tāʾ of the feminine. ﴿لَهُما﴾ attached to بدت. ﴿سَوْآتُهُما﴾ fāʿil; the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the clause is conjoined (maʿṭūfa). ﴿وَطَفِقا﴾ the wāw is a conjunction; طفق is an incomplete (nāqiṣ) past verb and the alif is its noun. ﴿يَخْصِفانِ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by the retention of the nūn; the alif is the fāʿil; the clause is the khabar (predicate) of طفقا, and the clause طفقا is conjoined. ﴿عَلَيْهِما﴾ attached to يخصفان. ﴿مِنْ وَرَقِ﴾ attached to يخصفان. ﴿الْجَنَّةِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿وَعَصى﴾ the wāw is a conjunction; عصى is a past verb indeclinable on the implied (muqaddara) fatḥa. ﴿آدَمُ﴾ fāʿil. ﴿رَبَّهُ﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿فَغَوى﴾ the clause is conjoined. ﴿ثُمَّ﴾ a conjunction. ﴿اجْتَباهُ﴾ a past verb and mafʿūl bihi. ﴿رَبُّهُ﴾ fāʿil; the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿فَتابَ﴾ the clause is conjoined. ﴿عَلَيْهِ﴾ attached to تاب. ﴿وَهَدى﴾ the clause is conjoined by the wāw. ﴿قالَ﴾ the clause is resumptive. ﴿اهْبِطا﴾ an imperative verb indeclinable on the deletion of the nūn; the alif is the fāʿil. ﴿مِنْها﴾ attached to اهبطا. ﴿جَمِيعاً﴾ ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿بَعْضُكُمْ﴾ mubtadaʾ (subject); the kāf is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿لِبَعْضٍ﴾ attached to عدو. ﴿عَدُوٌّ﴾ the khabar of بعضكم; the clause is in the position of accusative as ḥāl. ﴿فَإِمَّا﴾ the fāʾ is a conjunction; immā is the conditional in with the redundant (zāʾida) mā. ﴿يَأْتِيَنَّكُمْ﴾ an imperfect verb indeclinable on the fatḥa because it is joined to the heavy nūn of emphasis; the kāf is mafʿūl bihi. ﴿مِنِّي﴾ attached to يأتينكم. ﴿هُدىً﴾ fāʿil. ﴿فَمَنِ﴾ the fāʾ links the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ). ﴿من﴾ conditional, mubtadaʾ. ﴿اتَّبَعَ﴾ the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), a past verb in the position of jussive; its fāʿil is latent (mustatir). ﴿هُدايَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi; the yāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi; the clause is the khabar of the mubtadaʾ. ﴿فَلا﴾ the fāʾ links the apodosis and lā is negative. ﴿يَضِلُّ﴾ an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent; the clause is in the position of jussive as the apodosis. ﴿وَلا يَشْقى﴾ the wāw is a conjunction and lā is negative; the clause is conjoined. The clause ﴿فَمَنِ اتَّبَعَ﴾ is in the position of jussive as the apodosis of immā.

daas-irab:124-125.t: ﴿وَمَنْ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and man is a jussive conditional noun, mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿أَعْرَضَ﴾ a past verb in the position of jussive as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ); its fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir). ﴿عَنْ ذِكْرِي﴾ [a preposition and its genitive noun] attached to (mutaʿalliq) أعرض. ﴿فَإِنَّ﴾ the fāʾ links the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); inna is a particle resembling the verb. ﴿لَهُ﴾ attached to the fronted khabar (predicate). ﴿مَعِيشَةً﴾ its postponed noun. ﴿ضَنْكاً﴾ an adjective (ṣifa); the clause is in the position of jussive as the apodosis, and the two clauses of the condition and the apodosis are the khabar of the mubtadaʾ. The clause من … etc. is conjoined to the clause of the preceding apodosis, and its position is jussive like it. ﴿وَنَحْشُرُهُ﴾ the wāw is resumptive, and نحشر is an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent; the hāʾ is mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause is resumptive. ﴿يَوْمَ﴾ an adverb of time. ﴿الْقِيامَةِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the adverb is attached to نحشره. ﴿أَعْمى﴾ ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿قالَ﴾ the clause is resumptive. ﴿رَبِّ﴾ the one addressed (munādā) with an omitted vocative particle; رب is an accusative munādā because it is annexed to the omitted yāʾ of the first person. ﴿لِمَ﴾ the lām is a preposition, and mā is an interrogative noun whose alif was deleted to distinguish between the declarative and the interrogative, in the position of genitive by the lām; [the two are] attached to حشرتني. ﴿حَشَرْتَنِي﴾ a past verb, fāʿil and mafʿūl bihi; the nūn is for protection (wiqāya); the vocative clause and the one after it are the maqūl al-qawl (object of the saying). ﴿أَعْمى﴾ ḥāl. ﴿وَقَدْ﴾ the wāw is the wāw of circumstance (ḥāl) and qad is a particle of realisation (taḥqīq). ﴿كُنْتُ بَصِيراً﴾ kāna, its noun and its khabar; the clause is in the position of accusative as ḥāl.

dervis-irab:56-63.t:
* Vocabulary:
(ضُحًى): al-ḍuḥā is the sun shining forth after it has risen. The Arabs gave names to the hours of the day: the first is al-dhurūr, then al-buzūgh, then al-ḍuḥā, then al-ghazāla, then al-hājira, then al-zawāl, then al-dulūk, then al-ʿaṣr, then al-aṣīl, then al-ṣabūb, then al-ḥadūr, then al-ghurūb.
It is also said of them: al-bukūr, then al-shurūq, then al-ishrāq, then al-raʾd, then al-ḍuḥā, then al-mutūʿ, then al-zawāl, then al-hājira, then al-aṣīl, then al-ʿaṣr, then al-ṭafal, then al-ghurūb.
(فَيُسْحِتَكُمْ): He would destroy you; from the four-letter form أسحت, which is the dialect of Najd and Tamīm, meaning "to destroy". One also says سحت, which is the dialect of the Hijaz. The root of this material denotes exhausting something completely and bringing it to an end; from it comes «سحت الحالق الشعر», i.e. the shaver took the hair off completely and left none of it. It is used for destroying and doing away with something. In al-Qāmūs: «سحت يسحت, of the pattern fataḥa, and سحّت with doubling: he acquired suḥt, i.e. unlawful wealth; سحته: he destroyed him, uprooted him and slaughtered him; سحت الشحم عن اللحم: he peeled the fat off the meat; سحت وجه الأرض: he effaced it; أسحت: he corrupted it, destroyed it and uprooted it».

* I'rab:
(وَلَقَدْ أَرَيْناهُ آياتِنا كُلَّها فَكَذَّبَ وَأَبى): The lām is the response to an omitted oath; قد is a particle of affirmation (taḥqīq); أريناه is a past verb from رأى in the sense of seeing with the eyes, but it takes two objects because the hamza of transfer has entered it; نا is an attached pronoun in the position of nominative as fāʿil (agent); the hāʾ is the first mafʿūl bihi (direct object); آياتنا is the second mafʿūl bihi; كلها is tawkīd (emphasis) of آياتنا; فكذب وأبى are conjoined to أريناه. The nine signs of Moses have already been mentioned, then the last two signs, namely the staff and the drawing out of the hand.
(قالَ أَجِئْتَنا لِتُخْرِجَنا مِنْ أَرْضِنا بِسِحْرِكَ يا مُوسى): قال is a past verb and its fāʿil is latent (mustatir), its implied form being "he", i.e. Pharaoh; the clause أجئتنا is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl); the hamza is for the interrogative of disapproval; جئتنا is a verb, its fāʿil and its mafʿūl bihi; لتخرجنا: the lām is for giving the reason, and تخرج is an imperfect verb in the accusative (manṣūb) by an implied أن after the lām of reason; نا is the mafʿūl bihi; من أرضنا is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) تخرجنا, and بسحرك is attached to تخرجنا.
(فَلَنَأْتِيَنَّكَ بِسِحْرٍ مِثْلِهِ فَاجْعَلْ بَيْنَنا وَبَيْنَكَ مَوْعِداً لا نُخْلِفُهُ نَحْنُ وَلا أَنْتَ مَكاناً سُوىً): The fāʾ is the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa (the fāʾ indicating an implied condition), and the lām is the response to an omitted oath, its implied form being "By Allah, we shall surely bring you"; بسحر is attached to نأتينك; مثله is a naʿt (adjective) of سحر. It is also permissible for بسحر to be attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial), i.e. "accompanied by magic like it in strangeness, which would oppose it and refute it". فاجعل: the fāʾ is a conjunction and اجعل is an imperative verb whose fāʿil is "you"; بيننا is an adverb attached to an omitted second mafʿūl bihi, and بينك is conjoined; موعدا is a mīmī maṣdar (verbal noun with a prefixed mīm), the first mafʿūl bihi; the clause لا نخلفه is a naʿt of موعدا; نحن is tawkīd of the pronoun in نخلفه; the wāw is a conjunction, لا is negative, and أنت is conjoined to the pronoun in نخلفه. مكانا is a badal (substitute) from موعدا by implying a muḍāf, i.e. "the place of an appointment"; or مكانا may be parsed as accusative by removal of the preposition, i.e. "in a place"; or you may make it accusative by the maṣdar, which is موعد. سوى is a naʿt, i.e. "midway", and it is read with ḍamma on the wāw and with kasra. This is one of several parsings which will come in the section on Benefits.
(قالَ: مَوْعِدُكُمْ يَوْمُ الزِّينَةِ وَأَنْ يُحْشَرَ النَّاسُ ضُحًى): موعدكم is a mubtadaʾ (subject) and يوم الزينة is the khabar (predicate); أن and what follows it are conjoined to يوم الزينة: either to اليوم, in which case the position of the maṣdar is nominative, or to الزينة, in which case its position is genitive. الناس is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent), and ضحى is an adverb attached to يحشر. The discussion of the Day of Adornment and the reason for choosing it will come.
(فَتَوَلَّى فِرْعَوْنُ فَجَمَعَ كَيْدَهُ ثُمَّ أَتى): The fāʾ is a conjunction; تولى is a past verb and فرعون is the fāʿil; فجمع is conjoined to فتولى; كيده is the mafʿūl bihi on the omission of a muḍāf, i.e. "the possessors of his scheme", namely the sorcerers; ثم is a conjunction and أتى is conjoined to جمع. He expressed it with ثم to indicate that he spent time in gathering the sorcerers and drawing up plans.
(قالَ لَهُمْ مُوسى وَيْلَكُمْ لا تَفْتَرُوا عَلَى اللَّهِ كَذِباً): قال is a past verb, لهم is attached to it, and موسى is the fāʿil; ويلكم is a maṣdar of imprecation whose verb the Arabs let die out, so it is accusative by an omitted verb; لا is prohibitive and تفتروا is an imperfect verb in the jussive (majzūm) by لا; على الله is attached to تفتروا, and كذبا is the mafʿūl bihi.
(فَيُسْحِتَكُمْ بِعَذابٍ وَقَدْ خابَ مَنِ افْتَرى): The fāʾ is the fāʾ of causation (fāʾ al-sababiyya); يسحتكم is an imperfect verb in the accusative by an implied أن after the fāʾ of causation preceded by a prohibition; بعذاب is attached to يسحتكم. وقد: the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya) and قد is a particle of affirmation; خاب is a past verb; من is the fāʿil, and the clause افترى is its ṣila (relative clause).
(فَتَنازَعُوا أَمْرَهُمْ بَيْنَهُمْ وَأَسَرُّوا النَّجْوى): The fāʾ is a conjunction; تنازعوا is a past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on ḍamma because it is attached to the wāw of the plural, and the wāw is the fāʿil; أمرهم is the mafʿūl bihi, or accusative by removal of the preposition; بينهم is an adverb attached to an omitted ḥāl; أسروا is conjoined to تنازعوا, and النجوى is the mafʿūl bihi, i.e. they concealed it, meaning they consulted one another in secret.
(قالُوا: إِنْ هذانِ لَساحِرانِ يُرِيدانِ أَنْ يُخْرِجاكُمْ مِنْ أَرْضِكُمْ بِسِحْرِهِما وَيَذْهَبا بِطَرِيقَتِكُمُ الْمُثْلى): إن is lightened from the heavy (inna) and is inoperative; هذان is a demonstrative for the dual in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ; the lām is the lām of distinction (al-lām al-fāriqa); ساحران is the khabar of هذان; the clause يريدان is a naʿt of ساحران; أن and what is within its scope are the object of يريدان; من أرضكم is attached to يخرجاكم; بسحرهما is a ḥāl, i.e. "accompanied by their magic"; يذهبا is conjoined to يخرجاكم; بطريقتكم is attached to يذهبا, and المثلى is a naʿt of طريقتكم.

* Rhetoric:
In His saying «لا تَفْتَرُوا عَلَى اللَّهِ كَذِباً فَيُسْحِتَكُمْ بِعَذابٍ وَقَدْ خابَ مَنِ افْتَرى» there is the device of radd al-ʿajuz ʿalā al-ṣadr (returning the end upon the beginning), which the later scholars called al-taṣdīr; it is lighter on the ear and more fitting to the context. Its discussion has already been given, and we add here that Ibn al-Muʿtazz divided it into three types:
The first is where the last word of the first hemistich agrees with the last word of the second hemistich, or is homogeneous with it, as in the saying of one of them:
يلقى إذا ما كان يوم عرمرم ... في جيش رأي لا يفل عرمرم
(He meets, when there is a day of a vast army, [the foe] in an army of counsel that is not blunted — vast.)
The second type is where the last word of the verse agrees with its first word, as in the saying of another:
سريع إلى ابن العم يلطم وجهه ... وليس إلى داعي الندى بسريع
(Quick to his cousin, to slap his face, but not quick to the one who calls to generosity.)
The third type is where the last word of the verse agrees with part of a word in its first hemistich, as in his saying:
سقى الرمل صوب مستهل غمامه ... وما ذاك إلا حب من حل بالرمل
(May the downpour of its pouring cloud water al-Raml — and that is only out of love for the one who dwells at al-Raml.)
Shaykh Zakī al-Dīn ibn Abī al-Iṣbaʿ said: «What would be good is that the first type be called taṣdīr al-taqfiya (rhyme-taṣdīr), the second taṣdīr al-ṭarafayn (taṣdīr of the two ends), and the third taṣdīr al-ḥashw (taṣdīr of the middle)». The examples of this are many.

* Benefits:
The parsers differed greatly over the saying of the Exalted «فَاجْعَلْ بَيْنَنا وَبَيْنَكَ مَوْعِداً لا نُخْلِفُهُ نَحْنُ وَلا أَنْتَ مَكاناً سُوىً», and the truth is that it is one of the most difficult constructions. In the I'rab we chose the best of the options, the closest to logic and the nearest to ease. There remain matters that must be clarified:
موعدا: there is disagreement about it, along the following lines:
a- It is a noun of time; this is favoured by His saying «قالَ مَوْعِدُكُمْ يَوْمُ الزِّينَةِ», and the meaning is "appoint for us a time of meeting"; that is why he answered them with his saying: «موعدكم يوم الزينة».
b- It is a noun of place; this is favoured by His saying «مَكاناً سُوىً», and the meaning is "make clear to us a known place which we and you know, so that you come to it".
c- It is a mīmī maṣdar meaning "promise", and an omitted muḍāf is implied, i.e. "the place of a promise". This is supported by His saying «لا نخلفه نحن ولا أنت», because an appointment is described as being broken or not broken. This is what we chose.
If you make it a time, two things are binding on you: that you make the time something broken, and that what governs مكانا in the accusative is left over for you [Translator's note: i.e. you are left without a governor for مكانا]. If you make it a place, it is also binding on you to make the breaking fall on the place, and His saying «موعدكم يوم الزينة» would not correspond. So what remains is to make it a maṣdar meaning "promise", to imply an omitted muḍāf, i.e. "the place of an appointment", to make the pronoun in نخلفه refer to the appointment, and to make مكانا a badal from the omitted مكان.
Abū ʿAlī al-Fārisī and Abū al-Baqāʾ allowed مكانا to be accusative as the second object of جعل [Translator's note: the source prints «لا جعل قالا», apparently a corruption of «لاجعل، قالا» "of اجعل; they said"]; they said: موعدا on this view is also a place, and مكانا is not made accusative by موعدا because it is a maṣdar which has been qualified — meaning that it is valid as a second object, but on the condition that الموعد means the place, so as to correspond to the khabar.
Al-Ḥūfī made مكانا accusative as an adverb, made accusative by اجعل. Thus there result five options for the accusative of مكانا:
1- That it is a badal from the omitted مكانا.
2- That it is the second object of جعل.
3- That it is accusative by an implied verb.
4- That it is accusative by the maṣdar itself.
5- That it is accusative as an adverb by اجعل itself.
We cited these opinions only because they are close, and because taking them all in is extremely useful; so reflect.

dervis-irab:64-70.t:
* Vocabulary:
(فَأَجْمِعُوا): i.e. resolve upon your scheme and make it something agreed upon, so that you do not differ, like a question on which there is consensus. One says: اجمعوا الأمر and اجمعوا عليه. «فلانة بجمع» means she is a virgin; «ضربه بجمع كفه» (he struck him with his fist); «استجمع لفلان أمره» (his affair came together for him); «استجمع السيل» (the torrent gathered); and «استجمع الفرس جريا» (the horse gathered itself in running). He said, describing a mirage:
ومستجمع جريا وليس ببارح ... تباريه في ضاحي المتان سواعده
(One gathering itself to run yet not leaving its place, its streams vying with it on the sun-exposed hard ground.)
i.e. its channels. «استجمع الوادي» is said when no spot of the valley remains without flowing. It is reported from one of the Arabs: «Al-Rumma and Falj do not flow in full; they only flow in their sides and their outskirts». «استجمع القوم»: the people all went. «جمعوا لبني فلان»: they massed to fight them: «إِنَّ النَّاسَ قَدْ جَمَعُوا لَكُمْ فَاخْشَوْهُمْ». «أجمعت القدر غليا»: the pot came to a full boil. Imruʾ al-Qays said:
ونحشّ تحت القدر نوقدها ... بغضا الغريف فأجمعت تغلي
(And we stoke beneath the pot, kindling it with the ghaḍā wood of the thicket, until it came fully to the boil.)
And among the metonymies: «فلانة قد جمعت الثياب», i.e. she has grown up, because she wears the shift, the head-covering and the wrap.
(فَأَوْجَسَ): al-ījās is concealing; ījās al-khawf is concealing something of fear. Likewise «توجس الصوت» is to hear a slight sound of it. That was due to the nature of the human constitution.
(تَلْقَفْ): it swallows; its root meaning is taking something quickly. He said in al-Qāmūs: «لقف يلقف, of the pattern taʿiba, laqfan; and التقف الشيء: he took it quickly».

* I'rab:
